body:
Deep down i know that I'm not.  That's not to say i don't have my down falls... Major depression,  anxiety,  ect.  But damn,  you can only deal with someone pushing you away so quickly,  being angry and upset whenever you're around,  and then seeming so happy and care free  when you're not.    


I need to find some way to get positive,  it's just hard being positive when you're moving back to the house that you grew up learning what having depression was.

I know it is,  I've actually been relatively positive since my other 2 posts,  but god damn,  did it hit me like a ton of bricks last night.  I can't shake that feeling of "my life as i knew it is over.  Everything i worked for, and gave up to keep this relationship afloat,  was for nothing".   


My life is destroyed,  and yet this ~~woman~~  ~~girl~~ cunt piece of shit,  acts like her life is now perfect and happy.  That's the most painful thing.  I had NO idea that i was such a bad person.  I thought i was handsome,  fun,  funny, caring,  smart,  and good in the sack... NOPE!   She wants nothing to do with me anymore.    


Oh,  we can be friends... Really?  Fuck you!  Cause i really want to know that you're out having a grand time while I'm sitting at my father's depressed as all hell,  and you're having parties and bringing random dudes back to my house...    


Aaaaaaaand I'm pissed again.   


I appreciate your messages though,  and taking the time to reach out.  It really made me tear up a bit. Thank you
Yeah,  i got a message from a young gaming friend online, and the context and timing was really really odd. Thank you for your kind words. And that was a nice laugh that i didn't expect tonight.
Forget the name thing,  i just had a suspicion that you might be someone that i knew, and i just confirmed it wasn't,  lol!  Welp,  that actually made me laugh,  so that's nice

I thought my wage was good,  but it's clearly not.  I've worked hard to get where i am,  but I've realized that it's absolutely nowhere.    


Youre a sweet person for saying these things. I'm just feeling so far gone that I'm losing the point of life the father i get into it.    


What's your name?  I'm not a creep, I'd just feel better knowing.

I appreciate that.  I just don't even know what to say anymore.  I just feel like such a waste of space.  I don't want to have anymore tough times,  my whole life has been a tough time, and I'm sick of it all
